name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
research: Two moments of the alternation: picture 1 left curled (elbow 124) with right hanging (elbow 13); picture 2 the reverse. Both upper arms elev 7, plane 56 (by the side, slightly forward), fold forward, palms up (axis +x left, -x right). Angles converted from the approved dumbbell_curl clip positions: down hand-pivot (0.039, 0.10, -0.306) -> 13 deg; top (0.011, 0.249, 0.209) -> 124 deg. S1 Marcolin 2018 (this exact exercise, range 123 +- 12 deg, trunk policed), S2 Kleiber 2015, S3 ACE (elbows by the sides). Standing rest feet. Facts: research/alternating_dumbbell_curl.json.
